build_binding.rule: every executable rebuilt in the read-only source snapshot with its build record's command is byte-identical to it (sha256); the F1 tools are compiled in the same snapshot with the same commands

nonlinear.note: the vendored coefficients at the two loop means in exact (Fraction) arithmetic: a cross-check of the linear map (partial sums when graphs or loops are subsets)

projection.rule: |dC8| + 3 SE_d sqrt(n_mini/n_prod): the mean difference kept as a bias, the SE scaled

F4.metric: lane-thread seconds: threads x the sum of the native blocks' wall times (start-up, load, integration, output), median of the repeats
